question: Who among the following introduced the Mansabdari system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Akbar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Akbar**__ was the third Mughal emperor who reigned the dynasty from 1556 to 1605.
 
• The** Mansabdari system **was the administrative system during the Mughal period.
 __
 
• It was introduced by Akbar.
 
• The Mansabdari system was related to the** ranking of a government official.**
 
 
 
• **Todar Mal **was the revenue minister of Akbar.
 
• Abul Fazl wrote a three-volume history of Akbar’s reign, titled **Akbar Nama.**
 
• The historical structures built during the reign of Akbar are:
 
 
• Agra Fort.
 
• Lahore Fort.
 
• Fathepur Sikri.
 
• Allahabad Fort.
 
• Buland Darwaza.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shah Jahan** was the **fifth Mughal emperor** who reigned the dynasty from** 1628 to 1658.**
 
• The historical structures built during the reign of Shah Jahan are:
 
 
• Taj Mahal.
 
• Red Fort.
 
• Jama Masjid.
 
• Shalimar Garden in Lahore.
 
 
 
• French traveller **Bernier and Tavernier **visited India during the reign of Shah Jahan.
 
• Shah Jahan was imprisoned by his son** Aurangzeb** in 1658 in Agra.
 
• The Moti Masjid inside the Red Fort complex in Delhi was built by the Mughal emperor** Aurangzeb.**
 
• The Moti Masjid in Lahore Fort was built by Mughal emperor **Jahangir.**
